name: Cubing in the Lion's Den 2024

venue.name: Howard High School
venue.address: 8700 Old Annapolis Rd, Ellicott City, MD 21043

information:
Competition will be held in the school cafeteria.

When facing the school from Route 108, enter through the doors on the very left side of the school. There are stairs leading up to the entrance. Once inside, the cafeteria is on the left.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This competition is supported by CubingUSA.
